description: Published currentStructure example has columns.flow_type=2 outside schema enum [0,1], and string checklist ID "204" where the schema requires integer. Actual example parses in node tests; harness rejects it and falls back to an unresolved example $ref.

Published card examples have null planned_start_date_sync_type and planned_end_date_sync_type, while enum validation allows only [1,2,3] and [1,2]. These examples parse unchanged in node tests. Harness rejects them and falls back to unresolved example $refs.

CardComment oneOf author and sender/recipient schemas has neither required discriminator nor exclusive branches; both documented plain and emailed comments validate against both branches and fail oneOf. Actual examples parse in node tests; harness falls back to an unresolved example $ref.
Published UsersExample data[1].avatar is null but Users.avatar is a non-nullable string. It parses unchanged in node tests. Harness falls back to a generated envelope without data; advisory only.
